categories.main_business_segments: GreenTech Environmental Co., Ltd. primarily operates in water pollution control, sewage treatment and reuse, seawater desalination, rainwater and unconventional water source treatment, resource recycling, environmental emergency services, environmental consulting, software development, and intelligent water system integration. Its core products include AI-driven smart water plant operation platforms (Water Radish® AI Intelligent Body), smart water purification units (New Water Island®), and process package products for deep water treatment and wastewater resource recovery.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary membrane technologies including GTMOST® membrane universal platform technology, membrane anti-fouling technology, precise dosing, direct coupling, and crystallization softening technologies. It integrates AI and digital twin technologies to enable autonomous, unmanned smart water plant operations. The New Water Island® product line embodies modular, standardized, and industrialized production methods, enabling factory pre-assembly and rapid on-site installation. The Water Radish® AI Intelligent Body employs multi-modal AI models for process optimization, fault diagnosis, and autonomous monitoring.
categories.primary_customers_markets: GreenTech serves municipal governments, industrial enterprises, and industrial parks, focusing on To G (government) and To B (business) sectors. Key industries include semiconductor manufacturing, photovoltaics, chemical fiber, printing and dyeing, and other water-intensive or pollution-sensitive sectors. The company also targets emerging industries requiring high-quality water and wastewater resource recovery solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant projects in Beijing, Tianjin, Hebei, Jiangsu, Guangdong, and other provinces. It has expanded overseas with subsidiaries and partnerships in Hong Kong, Singapore, British Virgin Islands, Turkey, Indonesia, Saudi Arabia, and other international markets, focusing on Middle East, Southeast Asia, North Africa, Europe, and America.
categories.supply_chain_position: GreenTech operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the water treatment supply chain, providing integrated technology solutions, equipment manufacturing, project construction, and long-term operation and maintenance services. It also produces and sells resource recovery products derived from wastewater treatment.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on 'Resource Recovery, AI Digitalization, and Productization.' It invests heavily in R&D to advance water deep treatment and wastewater resource recovery technologies, AI-driven smart operation platforms, and modular product development. Collaborations with universities and research institutes support innovation in membrane technology, advanced oxidation, crystallization softening, and AI algorithms. The company aims to enhance unmanned operation capabilities and expand product applications across diverse water treatment scenarios.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through sales of smart water treatment equipment (New Water Island®), sales of process package products, software sales of the Water Radish® AI platform, production and sale of resource recovery products (e.g., regenerated water, inorganic salts), and operation and maintenance service fees. Business models include direct equipment sales, investment and operation projects, leasing, and O2O (online-to-offline) service models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: GreenTech is recognized as a leading high-tech enterprise in China’s water deep treatment and wastewater resource recovery sector. It holds a strong competitive position due to its proprietary membrane technologies, AI integration, and productization strategy. The company has received multiple national and regional awards and certifications, distinguishing it from competitors primarily focused on traditional water treatment engineering.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, GreenTech reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 617 million, a 7.74% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 66.8 million, a slight decrease of 5.62%. The company maintains a stable gross margin around 36%. Total assets reached RMB 2.3 billion, growing 8.59% from the previous year. The company’s order backlog was RMB 670.7 million as of year-end, reflecting a slight decline. R&D investment accounted for 4.78% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: GreenTech emphasizes delivering high-quality, sustainable water solutions through advanced membrane technologies combined with AI-driven autonomous operation, significantly reducing water treatment costs and environmental impact. Its New Water Island® product line offers modular, factory-produced, rapidly deployable smart water plants with reduced footprint and lifecycle costs. The Water Radish® AI platform enhances operational efficiency by replacing manual labor with intelligent decision-making, ensuring stable water quality and quantity. The company’s integrated approach addresses water scarcity, pollution, and cost challenges for municipal and industrial clients.
